Per-user and per-prompt detail | Model invocation logs, with the user taken from the `identity` ARN or a request-metadata tag |\\n| Both invoice-accurate dollars and per-prompt detail | Combine a {"id": "4785536b-6805-49c6-83f6-c0c68ff60616", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Yes. The `-mantle-` in that usage type means the traffic is billed as `bedrock-mantle` endpoint usage, so the mantle quotas govern it.

- **Usage type format:** The Bedrock billing docs list `{region}-{model}-mantle-{token-type}-standard` as the format for `bedrock-mantle` requests. `bedrock-runtime` standard-tier lines have no `mantle` segment. Your line, `USE1-anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-mantle-input-tokens-standard`, matches the mantle format. It means us-east-1, input tokens, standard tier.
- **Which quota applies:** The docs say inference on `bedrock-mantle` is governed by two per-model, per-Region quotas, input tokens per minute and output tokens per minute. In Service Quotas they appear as "Bedrock Mantle input tokens per minute for <model>". The console label you quoted may differ slightly from that, so search for "Bedrock Mantle" and pick the Claude Sonnet 5 entry in us-east-1.
- **Request limits:** The mantle endpoint has no requests-per-minute quota. Throttling comes only from the input and output token quotas.
- **Counting differences:** Cached input tokens read through prompt caching don't count against the input-tokens-per-minute quota. At admission, the input check counts your input tokens plus the requested `max_tokens`. The unused part is returned after the response completes. A high `max_tokens` can therefore cause throttling well below your real token volume.
- **Other quotas:** The `bedrock-runtime` per-model quotas (the "On-demand InvokeModel tokens per minute" family) are separate from the mantle ones. Don't use them to size mantle traffic.

- **Models without published quotas:** Models without published per-account token quotas don't show up in Service Quotas. That doesn't mean they're unlimited. If you can't find a Sonnet 5 mantle entry, that may be why.
- **Unconfirmed in your account:** I tried to list the Mantle quotas in your account (123456789012, us-east-1), but the Service Quotas query returned no matches. I can't confirm the exact quota name or current value from here. The filter may have missed it, or the quota may not be exposed for this model. Check the Service Quotas console for the value, and request increases through the standard Bedrock limit-increase process.

To confirm which endpoint your callers actually use, look at the SDK or client configuration. Calls to a `bedrock-mantle.<region>.api.aws` host mean mantle. The mantle CloudWatch metrics (`TotalInputTokens` at the account and model level) should also show your Sonnet 5 traffic. I can pull those for you if you want to compare peak input tokens per minute against the quota.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
